title: MVP: Implement CLI Commands - list/show/new/stage/approve
description:
Implement the five core CLI commands that users will actually use. CLI must call orchestrator directly (no IPC for MVP), create zjj workspaces (15 lines), and implement full swarm agent protocol.

## Implementation Tasks
1. Create src/commands/list.rs - list command with JSON output
2. Create src/commands/show.rs - show command with task details
3. Create src/commands/new.rs - new command with slug validation + zjj workspace creation
4. Create src/commands/stage.rs - stage command with pipeline execution
5. Create src/commands/approve.rs - approve command
6. Update src/commands/mod.rs - export all commands
7. Update src/main.rs - wire commands to CLI
8. Add tests for each command
9. Run moon run :quick to validate

## Key Requirements
- Zero panics, zero unwraps throughout
- Railway-Oriented error handling with anyhow::Result
- Use oya_pipeline::{list_all_tasks, load_task_record, save_task_record}
- Use zjj CLI for workspace isolation (15 lines of code)
- Support --json output format for automation
- Validate slugs (lowercase alphanumeric + hyphens, no path traversal)

## Acceptance Criteria
```bash
oya new --slug my-feature          # Creates task, exits 0
oya list                           # Shows all tasks, exits 0
oya show my-feature                # Shows task details, exits 0
oya stage --slug my-feature --stage implement  # Runs stage, exits 0
oya approve --slug my-feature      # Approves task, exits 0
```
